title: Scrum Master
description:
* Coach Scrum teams on Agile principles, practices, and methodologies, continuously ensuring Agile best practices are understood and followed.
* Serve as a servant leader to the Scrum team by:
* Addressing team concerns and facilitating resolution.
* Identifying and removing blockers and impediments.
* Facilitating Agile meetings and ceremonies, ensuring each meeting has a clear purpose and is conducted effectively and efficiently.
* Ensure the team remains aligned with product goals and sprint objectives.
* Manage and maintain Azure Boards to ensure day\-to\-day team activities, work items, and progress are appropriately tracked.
* Communicate and radiate information from the Scrum team to key stakeholders, including Product Owners, Project Managers, and Leadership by:
* Escalating product risks, issues, and blockers.
* Communicating team velocity and delivery progress.
* Creating, maintaining, and communicating Agile metrics and reporting.
* Support Product Owners by ensuring the Scrum team clearly understands:
* Release plans.
* Sprint objectives.
* Priorities and expected outcomes.
* Promote collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Manager, Software Development
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 OpenText™ Application Delivery Management (ADM) solutions enable organizations to deliver more and better software, faster than their competitors. Our solutions help clients automate DevOps, maximize value stream management (VSM), and accelerate critical activities across the digital value stream—from planning and development to testing and delivery.
   

  

 We are seeking a talented and experienced Manager, Software Engineering to join our team in Hyderabad, India. This role will lead software engineering teams responsible for developing and enhancing enterprise applications and AI\-powered capabilities that address the evolving needs of our global clients.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of technical expertise, engineering leadership, people management, client focus, and hands\-on experience with modern AI technologies, including GenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and MCP.
   

  

**What Role Offers**
* Lead and guide development teams working on small to medium\-scale software projects, ensuring delivery against agreed timelines, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Drive project planning, execution, release management, and people management, while ensuring effective coordination across cross\-functional teams.
* Provide strong technical leadership and hands\-on expertise in C\+\+ and/or Java, along with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Lead the development and enhancement of Windows/Linux\-based applications, leveraging strong C\+\+ and/or Java development skills.
* Drive the adoption and practical application of GenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and MCP across engineering initiatives.
* Identify client\-centric AI opportunities and translate business challenges into scalable and practical AI\-powered solutions.
* Design, develop, integrate, and consume web services using RESTful APIs.
* Work with middleware, application servers, infrastructure, and database technologies to develop reliable enterprise applications.
* Architect solutions that address client needs while ensuring security, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and performance.
* Evaluate and propose creative technical solutions and alternatives while balancing risk, complexity, effort, and business requirements.
* Translate high\-level business requirements into clear technical plans and execution strategies, working closely with stakeholders to ensure alignment.
* Drive the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including design, development, unit testing, integration testing, end\-to\-end testing, deployment, and production support.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional and client\-facing teams to understand requirements, resolve technical challenges, and deliver solutions that meet client expectations.
* Lead, mentor, and develop engineering team members while promoting AI\-assisted development practices, engineering excellence, and continuous learning.
* Help teams achieve sprint and release goals on time and within agreed quality standards.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to ensure plans, priorities, resources, and dependencies are effectively coordinated.
* Stay current with emerging technology and industry trends, particularly in software engineering, cloud, AI, and enterprise application development.


**What You Need To Succeed**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 2\+ years of experience in people management and/or project management.
* Strong hands\-on programming experience in C\+\+ and/or Java.
* Experience developing applications on Windows and/or Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with RESTful APIs, web services, middleware/application servers, infrastructure, and databases.
* Practical experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and MCP.
* Ability to identify AI opportunities from client/business problems and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Strong understanding of software architecture principles, including security, scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Strong understanding of the complete software development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing, deployment, and production operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring software engineering teams.
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, development plans, and actionable execution strategies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organizational, and time\-management skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced Agile development environment.


 Advantages
   

  

 In addition to the core requirements, the following skills and experience would be advantageous:
   

  

* Knowledge and experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud infrastructure/services.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development and architecture.
* Exposure to modern DevOps practices and tooling.
* Experience working with enterprise\-scale middleware, application servers, and database technologies.
* Experience with AI\-assisted software development and adoption of AI engineering practices.
* Experience working directly with global clients and distributed engineering teams.
* Experience working within structured engineering methodologies and processes.
* Strong ability to operate in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced, and Agile environment.
* Highly motivated, self\-driven, and able to work with minimal supervision.


 OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
   

  

 If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Senior Product Analyst I [T500-29661]
description:
**About Us:** 




**Marriott International Inc.** 
 , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine\-seat A\&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10,000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories.
 



 From such humble beginnings to becoming the world’s largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At
 **Marriott Tech Accelerator center** 
 (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting\-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences.
 



 Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International.
 



  





**Role Title:** 
 Senior Product Analyst
 



**Position Summary:** 




 Marriott International is seeking a Functional Product Manager to join the Hotel Websites (HWS) team. This role is ideal for a professional with 4\-6 years of experience in product management, business analysis, digital product delivery, or related disciplines. The Functional Product Manager will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, UX designers, quality engineers, and content teams to define, prioritize, and deliver features that enhance Marriott's global hotel website experience. The ideal candidate is customer\-focused, analytical, and skilled at translating business needs into clear product requirements, actionable user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand customer needs, business objectives, and operational requirements.
* Gather, analyze, document, and prioritize functional requirements for HWS initiatives and enhancements.
* Create and maintain user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and product documentation.
* Partner with engineering, UX, quality engineering, and content teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer impact, strategic priorities, and delivery timelines.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work with stakeholders to define feature scope, success metrics, and release priorities.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and validate delivered functionality against business requirements.
* Analyze website performance, customer feedback, business metrics, and user behavior to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to product roadmaps and support long\-term product planning and strategy discussions.
* Facilitate communication and alignment between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure product features align with accessibility, usability, and customer experience standards.
* Monitor feature adoption and help measure customer and business outcomes following releases.
* Support documentation, training, and stakeholder readiness activities for new capabilities.
* Demonstrate ownership of assigned product areas, proactively communicate risks and dependencies, and contribute to a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Digital Experience, E\-commerce, or a related field.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and functional specifications.
* Understanding of Agile development methodologies and Scrum practices.
* Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and supporting product documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize initiatives and effectively manage competing stakeholder needs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong collaboration, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience working on digital products, websites, mobile applications, or customer\-facing platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience using website analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, or similar solutions to support product decisions.
* Understanding of UX principles, customer journeys, usability best practices, and conversion optimization.
* Experience with content management systems such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or similar platforms.
* Exposure to A/B testing, personalization, experimentation frameworks, or data\-driven product optimization.
* Basic understanding of APIs, web technologies, and software development processes.
* Familiarity with hospitality, travel, e\-commerce, digital marketing, or related customer\-facing domains.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams in large enterprise environments.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 



* Consistently delivers well\-defined requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable efficient development and testing.
* Effectively prioritizes backlog items based on customer needs, business value, and strategic objectives.
* Build strong partnerships across business, product, and technology teams.
* Improves customer experience through data\-driven insights and feature enhancements.
* Supports the successful delivery of product initiatives aligned with business goals and customer outcomes.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a continuous improvement mindset.



  





**Education and Certifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**Work location:** 
 Hyderabad, India.
 



**Work mode:** 
 Hybrid
 



**Marriott’s core values:** 




 At Marriott, our core values make us who we are. We believe that success is never final. As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same—putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. Being part of Marriott Tech Accelerator means being part of a proud history and a thriving culture.

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise\-level customers.
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.

* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* A technically orietnted leader who is familiar with AWS, CI/CD Pipelines (Github) TDD/BDD practices, user level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb. Familiarity leading a MS Dynamics team is a plus.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Github Co\-Pilot is a plus
* Previous people leadership experience.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

title: Digital Products Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Digital \& Innovation group at USP is seeking a Product Manager who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Who we are looking for

The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.

Agile project management has emerged as a transformative approach to project delivery, and behind every successful Agile project, there is a dedicated team that manages the Agile framework with precision and finesse. * Demonstrated experience in conflict resolution

 Reviews user stories and acceptance criteria to ensure testability and quality coverage.
   

  

 Participates in sprint testing activities and supports release validation efforts.
   

  

 Creates test automation scripts using tools like Playwright and maintains regression suite.
   

  

 Performs API and interface testing using approved testing tools.
   

  

 Collaborates with developers, product owners, solution engineers and business analysts to troubleshoot issues and validate fixes.
   

  

 Contributes to automated regression suite development and maintenance.
   

  

 Leads or engages in environment validation, test data preparation, and deployment verification activities.
   

  

 Produces periodic QA reports and test event\-specific status updates, supported by relevant data, while proactively identifying and communicating risks \& dependencies.
   

  

 Produces test evidence and quality metrics to support release readiness.
   

  

 Hands\-on test execution for all types of testing needs, execute on test events, analyze defect trends, contribute to root cause analysis and produce status reports.
   

  

 Provides testing guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to junior team members when needed.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Special Skill Requirements
   

  

 Minimum 8 years of QA experience in Agile software delivery environments.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of Guidewire testing experience, mainly Guidewire PolicyCenter.
   

  

 Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (Rally)
   

  

 Experience with test automation tools (Playwright)
   

  

 Experience with API testing and integrations validation.
   

  

 Experience leading testing efforts across large transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Business Insurance products, workflows, underwriting, policy administration, and integrations.
   

  

 Experience with automation frameworks, API testing, and CI/CD practices.
   

  

 Experience coordinating UAT, internal and external teams on integrations and end\-to\-end testing, and release testing activities.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.
   

  

 Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality
   

  

**Additional Qualifications**
 Broad knowledge of insurance concepts, terminology, products, policy admin system and business processes
   

  

 Strong verbal, written, and listening skills, with the ability to adapt technical messages for business and technical audiences as appropriate.
   

  

 Excellent collaboration and team\-building skills, with the ability to influence and work effectively across teams.
   

  

 Strong ownership and accountability for individual and team deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps.
   

  

 Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment
   

  

 Agile Delivery and Collaboration
   

  

 Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities.
   

  

 Proactively identifies dependencies for test events execution, communicates and collaborates with cross functional teams
   

  

 Partners with Product Owners and developers to ensure acceptance criteria are testable and complete.
   

  

 Commits to sprint goals and proactively communicates risks, blockers, and testing status.
   

  

 Supports continuous testing and continuous delivery practices.
   

  

 Contributes to team quality improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing.
   

  

 Collaborate effectively across production owners, business analysts and agile teams, identify risks and mitigation plans as appropriate.
   

  

 Education and Certification Requirements
   

  

 High school diploma or equivalent required.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or related field preferred.
   

  

 Guidewire testing certification required
   

  

**Benefits**
 Competitive compensation and benefits package:
   

  

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development


 Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

title: TD And E - TD - Scrum Lead - Manager Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title: Manager II, Technical Scrum Lead**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

 EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 This role leads a team providing agile methodology services to cross\-functional technology\-related project(s) or product(s) teams, demonstrating technical expertise to improve productivity of teams and quality of work processes and outcomes. Project(s) or product(s) often have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also ensures agile best practices are embedded in delivery, manages stakeholder alignment, and drives team performance through metrics and continuous feedback.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Leads, builds, and coaches high performing teams in the delivery of technology\-related products or projects, ensuring team actions are aligned with project and business goals. Instruct and coach other professionals.
* Leads planning, team learning, and adaptation of processes to ensure the quality of team solutions.
* Enables a continuous learning environment, identifying ways to strengthen the team's understanding of Agile/Scrum concepts and principles as they relate to technical capabilities.
* Builds and applies methodology that supports the integration of changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology\-related product development.
* Recommends to the product owner and management in the definition and prioritization of technology\-related outcomes. Identifies trade\-offs between short and long term benefits to drive shared vision between the team and product owner.
* Ensures the application of agile frameworks to the development process to increase effectiveness of technology\-related product development or architecture.
* Removes roadblocks to technology\-related product development or architecture. Applies learnings to other development projects.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages stakeholder expectations regarding target scope, schedule, and budget.
* Helps teams estimate iteration deliverables and increase sprint velocity.
* Acts as a Subject Matter Expert for agile methodologies and best practices.
* Promotes continuous communication and monitors team dynamics to foster collaboration.
* Facilitates scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, demos, and iteration meetings.
* Manages development tracking systems (e.g., product and sprint backlogs).
* Motivates and acts as the glue that holds cross\-functional teams together.
* Monitors sprint progress and identifies impediments that hinder delivery.
* Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting to proactively identify performance degradation and application disruptions
* Perform end to end triage and in depth troubleshooting of production incidents by analysing logs, telemetry signals, and related diagnostic data to quickly identify root causes and restore service
* Design and build ML models that analyse telemetry, logs and metrics to predict and prevent incidents before they impact users.
* Implement best in class detection mechanisms to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and accelerate incident response
* Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time
* Build innovative, scalable alerting solutions across a heterogeneous technology landscape, including AWS, Unix, and Mainframe platforms.
* Develop and maintain synthetic monitoring to simulate real user interactions and ensure early detection of failures.
* Perform daily health checks, triage and troubleshoot alerts, and resolve issues to minimize downtime and user impact.
* Conduct trend analysis, identify recurring patterns, and partner with application teams to enhance system reliability and availability
* Lead and participate in standard incident management processes, leveraging incident playbooks, diagnostic tools, and technical expertise to quickly identify impact and restore service
* Proactively trigger incident management when early signals indicate potential disruption
* Review and act on maintenance notifications, service advisories, and platform updates to mitigate operational risks.
* Maintain a centralized incident response playbook, ensuring steps, processes, and escalation paths are clearly documented.
* Document incidents, recovery steps, and learnings, and communicate them to relevant stakeholders to drive continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with application (App) development teams to identify, diagnose, and resolve operational problems impacting the platform or applications.
* Act as a bridge between platform operations and development teams to ensure timely root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Work collaboratively with developers, DevOps engineers, and IT stakeholders to improve performance, reliability, and operational maturity.
* Continuously refine alerting to reduce false positives and false negatives.
* Stay current with emerging observability tools, monitoring strategies, and SRE practices.
* Promote and support adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across teams.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned
* Willingness to work in a 24×7 support model, as needed


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in Agile software development, with at least two years leading large cross\-functional teams on enterprise technology initiativesBachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field is required; graduate degree preferred.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification (mandatory); AWS Solutions Architect certification preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years of hands on experience as an operations engineer, full stack developer, or automation engineer.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Good to have skills include Agile team leadership, stakeholder management, sprint planning, backlog prioritization, velocity optimization, and use of agile tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps. Strong skills in collaboration, verbal and written communication, team motivation, time management, and critical thinking are essential.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, PMI\-ACP, or ICAgile Certified Professional.
* Demonstrated ability to build high\-performing agile teams, remove delivery blockers, and foster a culture of continuous improvement in fast\-paced, enterprise\-level environments.
* Experience working with Confluence.
* Experience monitoring and refining dashboards.
* Experience in continuous process improvement for process flows and workflows.


**Required Skills:**
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability collaborating with application teams, ability to handle escalations and troubleshoot complex application issues.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting logs to generate operational intelligence and accelerate incident resolution.
* Experience with observability, SRE principles, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve system reliability.
* Expert level knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Experience with REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, and distributed systems
* Strong tooling and automation skills using Python, Java, Selenium etc.
* Prior experience in incident management and stakeholder communication.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.
* Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Honeycomb, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or other similar tools
* Background in supporting Java\-based applications on AWS, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and deployment support.
* Experience with additional monitoring and visualization tools such as Splunk, Grafana, and ThousandEyes.
* Exposure to Unix and Mainframe environments.
* Experience in networking and troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Experience building AI/LLM\-powered applications (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent frameworks
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Project Delivery Leader
description:
**Meet Our Team**
 PegaSystems is seeking Client Success Journey Designers who partner with executives and product/delivery teams to design and realize measurable client outcomes. You will blend strategy, service design, strong negotiation, and storytelling to align stakeholders, shape outcome\-led roadmaps, and guide squads from vision to value—ensuring adoption, satisfaction, and sustained impact.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
 Pegasystems is seeking Tech Project / Program managers to join our dynamic team of Delivery Leaders at multiple levels.
   

  

* Co\-design the client success journey—from vision to value —using the blueprints, journey maps, and testable value hypotheses as a Solution Designer.
* Champion Pega Blueprint based Rapid Delivery
* Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI.


 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
   

  

**What You'll Do At Pega**
* Typically be involved in between one and two projects, including Pega, partner, or client\-led implementations
* Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI
* Drive account hygiene (timely and accurate contractual documentation, Project Status Reports (PSRs), Engagement Status Dashboards (ESDs), forecasts, and A/R collections)
* Act as a trusted advisor to the client on all aspects of Pegasystems engagement, leading communication and providing thought leadership so that the best system possible is implemented
* Advise on Pegasystems’ delivery methodology and how this can be harmonized with a client’s methodology; demonstrate a thorough understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum approaches to delivery


**Who You Are**
* 9\-12 years in consulting/professional services with 4\+ years leading cross\-functional engagements and/or product/program work; proven track record designing client journeys, conflict resolution, stakeholder mediation and landing measurable business outcomes.
* Experience in managing resources in Matrix or non\-direct reporting structures
* Knowledge of cloud migration strategies and legacy modernization approaches
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships at multiple organizational levels.
* Executive\-caliber written communication; storytelling; ability to simplify complex concepts into crisp narratives. Practical Agile experience (Scrum/Kanban); skilled in discovery\-to\-delivery orchestration and backlog management.
* Certifications (nice to have): PMP(preferred), PSM/CSM, PRINCE2, SAFe POPM/Lean Portfolio, Service Design (e.g., SDN)


**What You've Accomplished**
* Translate strategy into action with MVP definitions, outcome\-based road maps, and prioritized backlogs tied to OKRs/KPIs.
* Negotiate scope and priorities to protect outcomes while managing constraints; facilitate governance and issue resolution with senior stakeholders.
* Tell the story of value through executive\-ready narratives, data\-driven visuals, and compelling demonstrations that accelerate decisions and adoption.
* Coach teams on journey\-centric delivery and help mature practices, templates, and playbooks that scale success across accounts.
* Identify growth opportunities through realized outcomes, adoption signals, and stakeholder advocacy; contribute to proposals and SoWs.
* Step up to play Scrum Master or a Pega Business Architect role as required


 LI\-MC3
   

  

**Pega Offers You**
* A rapidly growing yet well\-established business
* The world’s most innovative organizations as reference\-able clients
* Analyst acclaimed technology leadership in a massive emerging market
* A fast\-paced, exciting, collaborative, and rewarding sales environment within innovative industries

title: Technical Engagement Lead
description:
The Role
 



 You'll own a portfolio of existing client accounts, reporting to a Sr Account Manager. Your job is to run each engagement — requirements gathered, scope signed off, work delivered, the client's team trained and using it — landing on the committed date and at the quality bar the client expects, every time, while stewarding your accounts' ongoing migrations. You coordinate the analysts and a cross\-functional team on each engagement without reporting lines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership, early.
 



 This role is a designed transition: within two quarters you move into an FDE or AM seat — the landing is decided with the leadership team based on where you've demonstrated the most strength. The move is part of the role's design, not a contingency.
 



 The Bar
 



 Client satisfaction is the top priority for this role, achieved through delivery excellence — project management and technical quality. Every engagement lands on time and at the quality bar clients expect, the client genuinely well taken care of throughout, and the work actually put to use — and the measure is whether the client ends the engagement a promoter: someone who'd recommend Saras unprompted.
 



 What You'll Own
 


1. **Land every engagement on time and at the quality bar clients expect.** 
 No quietly cutting corners to hit a deadline.
2. **Run the full cycle — requirements to sign\-off and adoption.** 
 Gather business requirements, get explicit sign\-off on scope and success criteria, deliver the work, train the client's team to actually use it, and confirm it's being used.
3. **Build a delivery sprint plan that leaves no room for ambiguity.** 
 Every cross\-functional team member knows exactly what success looks like for their task — ownership, success criteria, and dates that mean something.
4. **Keep the client genuinely well taken care of.** 
 Clear communication, no surprises, and the hard conversations handled directly and calmly when something's off track.
5. **Coordinate the analysts and cross\-functional partners on each engagement — without reporting lines.** 
 Catch problems early, remove blockers before they impact deadlines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership the moment a commitment is at risk.
6. **Steward your accounts' ongoing migrations.** 
 Keep them moving on schedule, and keep the client confident through them.



 What Winning Looks Like
 



**First 90 days:** 
 You've picked up the delivery cadence on your accounts, you know the book and the state of every migration cold, and you know exactly where each engagement stands against its committed dates and quality bar.
 



**Steady state:** 
 Every engagement you own lands on the agreed date, at the agreed quality bar, the client can point to it being used, and your clients would recommend Saras — and by the end of quarter two you've demonstrated the strengths that decide your FDE or AM landing.
 



 Who Thrives Here
 



 Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you've run multiple full cycles of requirements gathering, sign\-off, and usage.
 


* You've managed technical delivery or implementation projects — data, analytics, software, or systems — from requirements through go\-live, for 5\+ years.
* You're comfortable working hands\-on with SQL, either Tableau or Power BI, or data pipelines — enough to manage the delivery credibly and speak the team's technical language.
* You've held client conversations about scope, value, or renewals — enough commercial footing to see how delivery becomes revenue.
* You've conducted product or platform trainings directly with clients — comfortable being the face of adoption, not just the person who ships the work.



**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:** 



* Hands\-on experience building AI agents using tools like Claude Code to improve delivery efficiency.
* You've built production\-grade dashboards as React\-native web apps, using AI\-assisted development.
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent project\-management credential.
* Experience in pre\-sales at an analytics or consulting firm (2\+ years).

title: Operations Team Manager
description:
**About the Role:** 





 We are growing our Development,
 
**QA, DevOps, Mobile, and UI/UX teams** 

 and are looking for an experienced
 
**Team Operations Manager to run the daily and weekly check\-ins** 

 that keep everyone aligned, track who is working on what, and make sure people and resources get shifted around quickly when priorities change.
 
**You will work closely with Product Owners and Project Managers** 

 , giving them clear visibility into staffing and resourcing so they can plan ahead and keep projects on track.
 





 This is not a technical role. You do not need to write code or make technical decisions. Your job is to keep things organized, keep communication flowing between teams and make sure everyone has what they need to get their work done.
 




  





**What You will Do:** 



* Serve as the direct manager for staff across these teams,
 
**including regular 1:1s, goal\-setting, and performance reviews**
* **Run daily standups, sprint planning, and retro meetings** 

 across Development, QA, DevOps, Mobile, and UI/UX teams
* Handle day\-to\-day people issues like workload concerns, interpersonal conflict and morale before they become bigger problems
* Track capacity and staffing needs across teams and flag gaps or overload early
* Move people and resources between teams quickly when priorities shift
* Act as the liaison between individual teams and company leadership, translating business priorities into operational plans
* Work with Product Owners and Project Managers to align staffing with their plans and give them early visibility into resourcing risks
* Build and maintain visibility for leadership: status updates, headcount needs, risks, and blockers
* Coordinate with HR on staffing timelines and onboarding logistics, and manage day\-to\-day coverage planning when team members are out or projects need extra hands
* Be the go\-to person technical leads can rely on for anything outside pure technical execution like logistics, planning, people issues, resourcing.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* **5\+ years of experience** 

 in operations, program management, or team coordination
* **Solid project management experience,** 

 including tracking timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple concurrent teams and projects with different schedules and priorities
* Solid understanding of how Development, QA, DevOps, Mobile, and UI/UX teams work and rely on each other, so you can plan around their needs. No hands\-on technical skills required
* Strong people\-management fundamentals in coaching, feedback, conflict resolution, performance management
* **Experience running agile ceremonies** 

 (standups, sprint planning, retros) across multiple teams
* Experience improving how teams work and communicate especially in fast\-moving environments
* Comfortable using tools like Jira to manage schedules, track resources and keep projects organized
* Strong written and verbal communication since you will be translating between technical teams and business stakeholders regularly

title: Senior Product Associate - Co-Branded Card
description:
**Job Description**
 Unleash your expertise in product development and optimization by leveraging user research, analyzing metrics, and collaborating across one of the world's most innovative financial organizations.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Associate in Consumer \& Community Banking Team, you contribute to the team by leveraging your expertise in product development and optimization to make a significant impact, supported by user research and customer feedback to fuel the creation of innovative products and continuously improve existing offerings. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and play a crucial role in shaping the future of our products and ongoing success.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Partners with the Product Manager(s) to identify new product opportunities that reflect the needs of our customers and the market through user research and discovery
* Considers and plans for upstream and downstream implications of new product features on the overall product experience
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization, including engineering, design, data, marketing, sales, and customer support, to deliver high\-quality products and solutions to customers.
* Analyzes, tracks, and evaluates product metrics including work to time, cost, and quality targets across the product development life cycle
* Writes the requirements, epics, and user stories to support product development.
* Drive the product development lifecycle based on Cobrand product roadmap, from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to quality standards.
* Ensure the Card platform complies with regulatory requirements and industry standards for security and data protection.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a equivalent engineering field.
* 5\+ years of product management experience.
* Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle
* Experience in product life cycle activities including discovery and requirements definition
* Developing knowledge of data analytics and data literacy
* Strong understanding of APIs, Business process automation, payment processing, and card issuance technologies.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Banking, Financial Services, Fintech or payment processors is preferred.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Ability to influence and partner / collaborate to drive cross\-functional teams without authority.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make data\-driven decisions. Ability to analyze opportunities \& problems, recommend solutions, and communicate effectively \& confidently (both verbal and written)
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities. Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with clear structure and clarity.
* Applying design thinking (client journey, UX / UI, moments of truth) and comfortable explaining target state customer experiences to stakeholders and technology teams through wireframes and mockups. Prior work experience in API definitions and design with a good understanding of modern software stack and database knowledge a plus
* MBA or advanced MS degree is a plus


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

* Experience working in large enterprise digital transformation programs.

+ Oversee the design, development, and deployment of scalable ServiceNow capabilities, services, and solutions.

* Hands\-on experience with JIRA (backlog, workflows, reporting)

* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, and audit expectations
* Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery risks
* Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
* Ability to work on multiple work streams concurrently in a fast\-paced environment with extreme multi\-tasking and context switching.

title: Transformation Program Lead
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 The Transformation Program Lead is a high\-impact, execution\-focused role at the heart of our operational transformation agenda. Sitting within the Transformation Office, this individual acts as the on\-the\-ground engine of change owing the end\-to\-end delivery of discrete process transformation initiatives, from diagnostic and design through to implementation and BAU handover.
   

  

 This is not a strategy\-only role. We are looking for someone who can think like a consultant and execute like an operator — structuring complex problems with rigor, driving workstreams to resolution, and embedding sustainable change that outlasts their tenure on any given initiative.
   

  

 In this role you will partner with our Global Process Owners, operational teams in our global Client Delivery Centers, Product and Technology, as well as leaders across Client Delivery and in our Lines of Business to define and execute our plans, in a regulated, client\-centric, and compliance\-minded environment.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate**
 You are organised, analytical, and motivated by tangible outcomes. You are comfortable working through complexity and ambiguity, and you take ownership of your workstreams without needing to be micromanaged. You communicate clearly and confidently with a range of stakeholders, from operations analysts to mid\-senior leadership, and you take pride in delivering work to a high standard. You are eager to grow your program delivery and problem\-solving capabilities, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your contribution is visible and valued.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

**Program Delivery \& Execution**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned transformation workstreams, managing tasks, timelines, milestones, risks, and dependencies
* Develop and maintain detailed workstream plans, ensuring activities are logically sequenced and progressing on track
* Contribute to a culture of accountability and pace, proactively flagging blockers and helping to resolve them
* Maintain thorough documentation of processes, decisions, and outcomes throughout the engagement lifecycle


**Problem\-Solving \& Issue Resolution**
* Apply structured problem\-solving techniques to analyze complex operational challenges — breaking down issues, gathering and interpreting data, and forming clear recommendations
* Proactively identify risks and issues within your workstreams and escalate with proposed mitigations
* Exercise sound judgement to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery momentum


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Build effective working relationships with business, operations, and technology counterparts across assigned initiatives
* Prepare clear and well\-structured workstream updates, status reports, and risk logs for review by senior program leads and leadership
* Support the facilitation of working group meetings, workshops, and stakeholder sessions, ensuring actions and decisions are captured and followed up


**Team Contribution \& Development**
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to Business Analysts on the team, helping to structure their work and maintain quality standards
* Act as a collaborative and constructive team member, sharing knowledge and contributing to a positive team culture
* Continue to develop your own skills in program delivery, problem structuring, and stakeholder engagement


**Change Management \& BAU Handover**
* Assist in the design and documentation of target operating models, processes, controls, and performance metrics to sustain new ways of working
* Support BAU teams in preparing for handover, contributing to training materials, process documentation, and transition planning
* Participate in structured handover activities at program close, ensuring continuity and a clean transition to business\-as\-usual


**Essential**
 Skills \& Experience Required
   

  

* 5–8 years of professional experience, with a solid track record in program or project management, business analysis, process improvement, or management consulting
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver structured workstreams within complex, cross\-functional programs
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to interpret data, identify issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing written updates and facilitating working group sessions
* Well\-organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams concurrently
* A proactive, self\-starting approach with a strong sense of personal ownership and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, or AI\-assisted workflows)

* Prior exposure to a Transformation Office or similar centre of excellence
* Familiarity with change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci, Kotter) and/or project management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, PMP)
* Undergraduate degree from a leading institution; postgraduate qualification an advantage


 What we offer
   

  

* A high\-visibility, high\-impact role at the centre of the firm's transformation agenda
* Exposure to a breadth of strategic initiatives across the business
* A clear career pathway into senior transformation leadership, change, or operations roles
* The opportunity to build and shape a best\-in\-class Transformation Office capability
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience

 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
