title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**
**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**
**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**
**About EA**
 Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.
   

  

 We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.
   

  

 Join us in driving the next revolution in games.
   

  

**Help Us Create Games Players Love To Talk About**
 EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.
   

  

 In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.
   

  

 This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product and Creative Collaboration
+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.

* Campaigns and Game Launches
+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.

* Market Research:
+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.

* Player Insights:
+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.


**Must Have**
* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.


**Good To Have**
* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.


**What Success Will Look Like**
 During the internship, the intern should be able to:
   

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.


**Sample Internship Projects**
 Depending On The Team’s Priorities, The Intern Will Be Assigned To a Game Team, And They May Work On Projects Such As
   

  

* Creating go\-to\-market strategy for a new game under development
* Analyzing the new player onboarding funnel and recommending improvements.
* Conducting a competitive review of progression or social systems.
* Identifying causes of player churn within a specific segment


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Manager, Software Development - 149
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Description**
 The Software Development Manager – Java \& SaaS (AI\-Assisted Development) will lead delivery execution for a small engineering team at Infor’s Hyderabad Development Center. The role requires 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including 4\+ years of hands\-on Java development, 2\+ years of technical leadership or engineering management experience, exposure to AWS\-based SaaS product development, and practical use of AI\-assisted software development tools to improve SDLC productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
* Introduce practical AI\-assisted development practices using approved tools and team workflows.
* Help the team use AI tools for requirements clarification, code understanding, first\-draft code generation, test case creation, documentation, defect analysis, and productivity improvement.
* Establish basic guardrails for responsible AI usage, including human review, validation of AI\-generated output, secure handling of enterprise data, and accountability for final deliverables.
* Lead a small team of developers, business analysts, and QA engineers through sprint planning, execution, quality checks, release readiness, and production support.
* Provide technical guidance for Java\-based SaaS business application development, including design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, refactoring, and defect resolution.
* Remain hands\-on in the codebase: contribute code, pair on hard problems, and build rapid prototypes and technical spikes with AI\-assisted tooling to test feasibility and settle design questions before the team commits to an approach.
* Support development of scalable, secure, multi\-tenant SaaS applications on AWS, with attention to tenant isolation, configurability, performance, reliability, observability, and operational readiness.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical tasks in partnership with BAs, product owners, QA, and engineering stakeholders.
* Ensure the team follows SDLC and Agile practices, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, release management, and post\-release support.
* Promote engineering discipline through clean code, secure coding, automated testing, CI/CD, source control hygiene, documentation, and peer review.
* Identify delivery risks, technical blockers, quality issues, and dependencies early, and communicate mitigation plans clearly.
* Mentor team members and encourage practical knowledge sharing across development, BA, and QA functions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* AI\-assisted development: AI\-assisted software development tools for coding, debugging, test generation, documentation, and productivity improvement.
* AI and LLM practices: Prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding, human\-in\-the\-loop review, validation of AI\-generated outputs, responsible AI usage, and practical application of LLMs in SDLC workflows.
* Application development: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, SQL, enterprise web applications, service\-oriented architecture, and business application development.
* SaaS architecture: Multi\-tenant SaaS design, tenant isolation, configurability, scalability, availability, integration patterns, performance, and production readiness.
* Cloud platform: AWS\-based application delivery, deployment, monitoring, logging, security controls, CI/CD, and production support.
* Engineering practices: Agile/Scrum, SDLC governance, automated testing, code reviews, secure coding, observability, incident analysis, and continuous improvement.
* DevOps and platform exposure: CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, monitoring tools, and cloud operational practices.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deeper experience with AI\-based software development tools, LLM\-based engineering workflows, prompt engineering, agentic development practices, MCP integrations, test generation tools, documentation assistants, or AI\-enabled project management workflows.
* Prior experience as a technical lead, senior developer, module lead, or team lead for a small software delivery team.
* Hands\-on exposure to AWS cloud services, microservices architecture, DevOps practices, containerization, observability, automated testing frameworks, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience building or supporting multi\-tenant SaaS business applications on AWS or similar cloud platforms, including tenant isolation, scalability, service reliability, configuration management, monitoring, and secure operations.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional delivery across development, BA, QA, product, and support teams.
* Understanding of security, compliance, accessibility, and data privacy considerations in enterprise software development.


**About Infor**
 Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real\-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next.
   

  

 Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. Over 60,000 organizations worldwide rely on Infor to help overcome market disruptions and achieve business\-wide digital transformation.

description:
**Job Description**
 MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
 **Consultant** 
 in a
 **PMO Role** 
 . We are looking for a highly motivated individual with extensive experience in leading large\-scale complex projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for assisting Project Managers to ensure on\-time, within scope and within budget delivery while meeting defined goals and maintaining MTX quality standards.
   

  

 MTX is a global technology consulting firm that enables organizations to modernize through digital transformation. With data as the new currency, MTX helps transform long\-term strategy with outcomes in mind around happiness, health and the economy. MTX improves decision\-making with speed and quality by partnering with leading cloud technologies. MTX provides expertise across various platforms and technologies, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Salesforce, artificial intelligence/machine learning, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, visualization, and mobile technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Consultant is expected to ensure project implementations align with client business goals, driving project success and sustainability while executing the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Client Relationship Management:
* Support in managing stakeholder relationships by providing updates on project progress.
* Support in addressing client queries and minor issues to ensure smooth communication.
* Support in monitoring project deliverables to meet client standards and maintain satisfaction.
* Help gather client feedback and contribute to improving service delivery.
* Project Planning and Execution:
* Support the development of project plans, including setting up timelines and identifying key milestones.
* Assist in tracking project schedules, resources, and budgets, ensuring tasks are completed on time.
* Help identify potential issues and risks, escalating them to senior team members as necessary.
* Maintain project documentation and ensure accurate tracking of project progress.
* Financial Management:
* Assist in monitoring project budgets and expenses, ensuring alignment with forecasts.
* Help manage vendor invoices and contracts, ensuring timely payments and compliance.
* Support in preparing basic financial reports and updates for review by senior team members.
* Communication and Reporting:
* Prepare and distribute weekly status reports, highlighting key updates and any issues.
* Assist in organizing and scheduling meetings, ensuring relevant stakeholders are informed and engaged.
* Communicate project updates to the team, ensuring alignment and understanding of project goals.
* Continuous Improvement and Best Practices:
* Participate in team training sessions and workshops to enhance personal and team skills.
* Assist in identifying areas for improvement within project processes and suggest enhancements.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices to contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
* Organization Development:
* Mentorship and Guidance:
+ Provide mentorship and guidance to the entry professionals, fostering their professional growth and development within the team.

* Growth and Development of Project/ Regional teams:
+ Participate in the hiring process to identify top talent for the projects in the region per the need.
+ Support HR team in performance documentation of project team members.

* Contribution to the COE (Center of Excellence)
+ Contribute to the development of COE with relevant deliverables and assets.

* Operational Excellence:
+ Maintenance of Salesforce Certifications.
+ Required to travel for key project milestones.
+ Maintain utilization goals.


**What you bring:**
* 5\-8 years of experience in PMO, project coordination, or IT consulting supporting large\-scale client delivery programs.
* Proficient in understanding the platform, including its architecture, data model, features, and capabilities.
* Competent in developing a comprehensive project plan and milestones.
* Competent in managing stakeholder relationships, providing regular project updates, and resolving any issues that may arise, ensuring clear communication and understanding of client needs.
* Competent in allocating resources, managing vendor contracts, and providing regular financial reports to stakeholders and mitigating any financial risk.
* Proficient in using project management tools like MS Project Plan, BEANS, MS Office Timelines.
* Proficiency in maintaining key relationships with clients and building new relationships.
* Excellent collaboration and risk management skills.
* Experience working with cross\-functional globally distributed teams.
* Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal skills with a user centric approach to problem solving.
* PMP certification/Master or diploma in Project Management is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree and above is desirable.


**What we offer:**
* Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan \- Self \+ Spouse \+ 4 Dependent Children)
+ Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/\-
+ Maternity cover upto two children
+ Cashless \& Reimbursement facility
+ Access to free online doctor consultation

* Personal Accident Policy (Disability Insurance) \-
+ Sum Insured: INR. 25,00,000/\- Per Employee
+ Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
+ Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
+ Temporary Total Disability is covered

* Optional Food Wallet (up to Rs. 8800 per month)
+ Offered as a tax saver component
+ Part of the special allowance component in the CTC

* Monthly Internet Reimbursement of upto Rs. 1,000
* Professional Development opportunities through various MTX\-sponsored certifications on multiple technology stacks, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS \& others

title: Project Management Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and proactive individual to manage small projects end to end and to support Project Managers and Project Analysts in the day\-to\-day coordination, tracking and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) projects across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will independently run small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives using the team's SWAT and Transition frameworks, while acting as the operational backbone of the Projects team – keeping plans, trackers, action logs and evidence current; scheduling and minuting governance forums; chasing actions to closure; and ensuring the team's tools and templates are consistently used. This is an individual contributor role in the Projects team with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects, and is the foundation for a career in project and programme management at Alter Domus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Small Project Management**
* Independently manage small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives (e.g. single\-team process changes, small work transfers or Transition Lite items, tooling or reporting roll\-outs, remediation actions) from kick\-off to closure, applying the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks proportionately
* Define scope, success criteria, timeline and stakeholders for small projects with the Business / CD Lead, publish a simple plan and run regular check\-points to drive the actions to completion
* Identify and log risks, issues and dependencies for own projects, resolve them at working level and escalate to the Head of Projects or a Project Manager where a decision or intervention is required
* Provide status updates on own projects into the team's weekly reporting and governance forums and complete closure and lessons\-learnt documentation


**Project Coordination \& Tracking**
* Maintain project plans, trackers and checklists for assigned projects – including the Transition Checklist, recruitment / onboarding tracker, access and IT tracker, training completion records and impacted\-teams register – ensuring they are accurate and up to date at all times
* Track actions, owners and due dates from all project meetings and proactively follow up with owners across Business, Tech, Client Delivery and cross\-functional teams to drive closure
* Support the Project Manager / Project Analyst in preparing detailed plans, timelines and milestone schedules and in updating them as the project evolves
* Own defined workstreams within larger Transition and Transformation projects under the guidance of a Project Manager


**Governance Forums \& Toll Gate Support**
* Organise and support governance forums – schedule Tier 2 (weekly) and Tier 3 (operational) meetings, bi\-weekly transition reviews and toll\-gate (TG1/TG2/TG3\) reviews; prepare agendas, circulate pre\-reads, capture minutes, decisions and actions and distribute them promptly
* Collect, file and index toll\-gate evidence (sign\-off emails, approved plans, acceptance forms, training and access confirmations) in the designated SharePoint / Confluence locations and keep the evidence checklist current
* Chase pending sign\-offs from LoB, CD Leads, GPOs, Academy, IT and Control Tower ahead of toll\-gate dates and flag anything at risk to the Project Manager
* Maintain the decision log and action log for assigned projects


**Risk, Issue \& Dependency Logging**
* Capture risks, issues and dependencies raised in meetings and by stakeholders into the RAID log with clear descriptions, owners and target dates
* Monitor open items for ageing and overdue status and highlight them to the Project Manager / Project Analyst for escalation
* Support the preparation of escalation notes and mitigation trackers


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Prepare first drafts of status reports – weekly project updates, the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update and governance packs – by collecting inputs from Project Managers, Tech PMO and stakeholders and populating the standard templates
* Update KPI trackers and dashboards (hiring progress, onboarding, training completion, KC/KT scorecards, milestone status) with validated data from source teams
* Maintain project documentation – charters, stakeholder lists, RACI, communication plans, SOP / process documentation packs received from LoBs – with correct version control
* Ensure all project artefacts are stored in the agreed structure on SharePoint / Confluence and are easy for stakeholders to find


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication**
* Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact for routine queries, data requests and scheduling across global delivery locations and time zones
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams – Talent Acquisition, Academy (KC/KT), IT / Access, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Facilities and Control Tower – to obtain inputs and confirm completion of their actions
* Draft clear and professional meeting invites, minutes, follow\-up notes and status communications for review by the Project Manager
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders and represent the Projects team professionally


**Tools, Templates \& PMO Administration**
* Administer Jira boards, Confluence spaces and SharePoint libraries for assigned projects – creating and updating items, maintaining workflows and access lists and ensuring data hygiene
* Apply the team's standard templates (Transition Acceptance Document, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates, status report and RAID templates) and suggest practical improvements based on usage
* Support onboarding of new project stakeholders to the team's tools and ways of working
* Support post\-project reviews by collating feedback, lessons learnt and closure documentation


**PROFILE**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations or related field
* Project management foundation certification (CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile / Scrum fundamentals) or willingness to obtain within the first year
* Overall 3\-7 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
* 2\-5 years of project coordination and execution experience – supporting or running projects, workstreams or process changes in a project, PMO or operations role
* Exposure to transitions, process migrations, change initiatives or working with global / multi\-location teams an advantage


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in Excel (pivots, lookups, basic charts), PowerPoint and Outlook; exposure to Power BI an advantage
* Working knowledge of collaboration and project tools – SharePoint, MS Teams, Jira, Confluence or equivalent
* Familiarity with basic project management concepts – plans, milestones, RAID logs, action tracking, minutes


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression

* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program

title: Principal Scrum Master
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The team is hiring a Principal Scrum Master to strengthen governance, controls, documentation, and auditability processes supporting the ServiceNow platform for Enterprise Change, Incident, and Problem Management. The role will partner closely with stakeholders across the organization to drive Agile delivery, improve operational efficiency, and ensure adherence to governance standards within a highly regulated financial services environment
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Manage bi\-weekly sprint execution and delivery tracking.
* Coordinate and communicate with multiple stakeholders regarding deliverables, dependencies, and approvals.
* Identify, track, and remove impediments impacting delivery.
* Manage backlog intake, user stories, and sprint reporting.
* Maintain documentation, governance controls, and audit trails.
* Drive process improvements and adoption of Agile best practices.
* Ensure all work and decisions are properly captured in Jira for audit and compliance purposes.


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Scrum certification.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Jira.
* Experience working as a Scrum Master within a large financial services organization or major financial institution.
* Proven stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing Agile delivery, sprint processes, and backlogs.
* Strong governance, controls, documentation, and auditability mindset.
* Experience supporting regulated environments with compliance requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to ServiceNow.
* Experience supporting Change Management, Incident Management, or Problem Management functions.
* Background implementing Agile best practices and improving team efficiency.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Specialist, Business Agility
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Scrum Master with experience leading cross\-functional teams to support business functions. In this role, you’ll facilitate agile delivery across a broad range of initiatives including data platform enhancements, dashboard development, automation, and data product delivery. The ideal candidate combines agile expertise with strong communication skills and a foundational understanding of data life cycles, analytics tooling, and enterprise project delivery.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Serve as Scrum Master for 1–3 Agile teams focused on delivering data and analytics solutions.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.
* Collaborate with Product Owners to groom and maintain a well\-defined backlog aligned to business priorities.
* Remove blockers and support teams in achieving sprint goals and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate across stakeholders in IT and different business teams.
* Track team metrics (velocity, burn\-down, etc.) and report progress to leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, agility, and transparency.
* Ensure alignment to Agile best practices, scaling frameworks (e.g., SAFe), and delivery standards.
* Support onboarding of new team members and promote team engagement.


**What Should You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or any related field.
* 3\-7 years of experience as a Scrum Master in a technology or data environment.


**Primary Skills (must\-have)**
* Hands\-on experience with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally)
* Strong facilitation, communication, and servant leadership skills
* Exposure to data projects (e.g., data pipelines, BI dashboards, data governance, reporting)
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams across IT and business units
* Scrum Master Certification (CSM, PSM, or equivalent)


**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**
* Relevant certifications
* Experience in large enterprise settings or highly regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance)

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

 At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
   

  

 If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
   

  

**Desired Candidate Characteristics**
* Have a strong commitment to a career in technology with a passion for healthcare
* Ability to understand the needs of the business and commitment to deliver the best user experience and adoption
* 10\+ years of experience in all phases of SDLC involving Analysis, Design, Development, Deployment, Testing, and Implementation of Web \& Client/ Server \& cloud applications.
* 10\+ years’ experience in IT with demonstrated success in supporting and delivering scientific applications, COTS applications and custom\-built solutions.
* Proficient in project management software such as Microsoft Project, JIRA, Asana, or Trello.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills across multiple teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving abilities and communication skills.
* Innovative and inquisitive nature to ask questions, offer bold ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Agility to learn new tools and processes.
* Knowledge of cGXP and 21CFR Part11 standards.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Accountable for the controlled production support and life cycle management for multiple applications used by Pharmaceutical Development and Global supplies within PDS.
* Build and develop the project team to ensure maximum performance, by providing purpose, direction, and motivation.
* Lead projects from requirements definition through deployment, identifying schedules, scopes, budget estimations, and implementation plans, including risk mitigation.
* Collaborate with Business and IT Plan functions to develop solutions for business problems including defining business requirements, provide project timelines and budget, develop acceptance criteria, testing, training, and change management plans.
* Contributes heavily towards developing a plan for development activities and translates those into actionable projects. These include releases, required modifications and discretionary enhancements to support the application life cycle.
* Accountable for managing day to day operational support, enabling the business to scale while improving key performance indicators impacting their efficiencies and improving overall customer experience. Defined both long\-term strategies and short\-term/immediate resource needs.
* Accountable for delivering on project implementations and operational support commitments.
* Collaborate directly with the business clients, IT Business Partners and other IT functions on delivery of digital capabilities.
* Monitor IT service provider resource consumption, review demand and change requests for support work related to custom applications.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Requires advanced knowledge applicable to a wide range of work in own function and thorough knowledge of other functions, typically gained through a university degree and 10\+ years of experience.
* May lead initiatives related to continuous improvement or implementation of new technologies. Works independently on most deliverables.
* Responsible for the direct management of a team including results/outcomes, goal setting, performance management, coaching.
* Has significant input into decisions related to hiring, performance reviews, promotions, and compensation actions.
* People manager level with supervisory responsibility for Individual Contributor and People Manager positions
* Responsible for a large sub\-function or multiple teams doing similar work.
* Demonstrates ability to build and leverage relationships through diplomacy with a broader focus within the Function.
* Articulates and presents complex information clearly and concisely across all levels. Ability to demonstrate in\-depth knowledge and expertise thereby establishing a strong reputation for themselves and the team.
* Participates in decision making and brings a variety of strong views and perspective to achieve team objectives.
* Looks for challenging opportunities and focus on building strong capabilities. Encourages and coach others to do the same.
* Demonstrates a focus on improving processes, structures and knowledge within the team. Leads in analyzing current states, deliver strong recommendations in understanding complexity in the environment, and the ability to execute to bring complex solutions to completion.

**Senior Application QA**

You will contribute to the design and execution of testing strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, participate in release activities, and help continuously improve our overall quality engineering capability.

**Key Responsibilities**

 API \& Integration Testing

 Test Planning \& Delivery
 


  
 



* Participate in Sprint Planning, backlog refinement and estimation sessions.


* Prepare test plans, test scenarios and execution schedules.


* Estimate testing effort for new functionality.


* Maintain full traceability between requirements, test cases and defects.


* Support delivery planning across multiple releases.





 Defect Management

* Perform root cause analysis alongside development teams.


* Validate defect fixes and regression impacts.


* Ensure defects contain sufficient evidence for efficient investigation.


* Monitor defect trends and recommend process improvements.





 CI/CD \& DevOps
 


  
 



* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


* Support continuous testing practices.


* Execute automated smoke tests following deployments.


* Support release validation activities.


* Help improve deployment quality through automation.





 Production \& Release Support
 


  
 



* Participate in release readiness activities.


* Perform post\-deployment validation.


* Support investigation of production incidents.


* Assist with root cause analysis and hotfix validation.


* Support production release sign\-off where appropriate.





 Test Data \& Environment Management
 


  
 



* Prepare and maintain appropriate test data.


* Coordinate environment readiness for testing activities.


* Support environment troubleshooting.


* Ensure data integrity throughout testing.





 Non\-Functional Testing Support
 


  
 





 Support and contribute to:
 

  
 



* Performance Testing


* Load Testing


* Accessibility Testing


* Compatibility Testing


* Security Testing




 Working alongside specialist teams where required.
 

  
 






 Agile Delivery
 


  
 



* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies.


* Collaborate with cross\-functional delivery teams.

* Promote quality ownership across the delivery team.





 Continuous Improvement
 


  
 



* Recommend improvements to testing processes, tools and frameworks.


* Contribute to QA standards and documentation.


* Mentor junior QA engineers.


* Share knowledge and best practices across the team.


* Promote a quality\-first engineering culture.



**Required Skills \& Experience**

title: Senior Manager, Agile Transformation, Commercial Ops
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Agile Transformation Leader will be accountable for driving measurable business outcomes through Agile transformation, scaled execution, and continuous improvement across CCFT. This role will ensure that CCFT staff, product teams, Agile Release Trains, and leaders effectively leverage SAFe practices, Agile governance, product delivery disciplines, and performance metrics to improve speed, quality, predictability, customer value, and strategic alignment.
   

  

 This role will serve as a senior transformation leader, coach, people leader, and change agent focused on translating Agile ways of working into tangible business impact. The Agile Transformation Leader will partner closely with CCFT leadership, Agile Enablement, product teams, and global stakeholders to improve delivery effectiveness, strengthen execution accountability, and build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous value delivery.
   

  

 AIN Scrum Masters within CCFT will report directly to this role, and SM across geographies will have a dotted line of reporting.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Business Outcome\-Driven Agile Transformation**
* Lead Agile transformation across CCFT with a clear focus on improving business outcomes, delivery predictability, product value, stakeholder satisfaction, operational efficiency, and time\-to\-market.
* Assess Agile maturity across teams and Agile Release Trains to identify opportunities that directly improve execution, flow, quality, transparency, and value realization.
* Develop and implement Agile maturity accelerators that help teams move beyond process adoption toward measurable improvements in delivery performance and business impact.
* Partner with CCFT leadership to align Agile practices, team priorities, and product execution with strategic business objectives.
* Drive transformation initiatives that improve how CCFT plans, funds, prioritizes, delivers, measures, and continuously improves product and technology outcomes.
* Strengthen our operation and execution excellence by focusing on Incident Management and Live narratives across product teams within Commercial Tech.


**People Leadership and Agile Capability Building**
* Provide direct management, leadership, and mentorship to Scrum Masters/BA, ensuring their work is aligned to business priorities, team outcomes, and Agile delivery excellence.
* Shortlist, interview, hire, onboard, and develop Scrum Masters who can enable high\-performing teams and improve delivery outcomes.
* Mentor Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, Product Analysts, and Product Managers to strengthen Agile execution, product thinking, stakeholder alignment, and outcome\-based delivery.
* Establish clear expectations for Agile roles with an emphasis on value delivery, impediment removal, decision enablement, and continuous improvement.
* Support performance development for Agile delivery roles by connecting individual contributions to team maturity, product outcomes, and organizational goals.


**Coaching, Mentoring, and Enablement**
* Coach Global CCFT teams and leaders on applying SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product management practices in ways that improve business agility and execution effectiveness.
* Provide practical guidance to teams on Agile events, roles, planning, prioritization, dependency management, and delivery practices that support better business outcomes.
* Deliver training, enablement sessions, and workshops that help teams, leaders, and stakeholders understand how Agile practices enable faster decisions, better alignment, improved quality, and increased value delivery.
* Facilitate workshops focused on outcome\-based planning, product alignment, Agile governance, continuous improvement, and SAFe adoption.
* Promote shared learning across teams to scale proven practices and improve Agile capability across CCFT globally.


**Agile Governance, Metrics, and Value Measurement**
* Enable Agile governance practices that improve transparency, accountability, decision\-making, and business alignment across CCFT product teams and Agile Release Trains.
* Establish and promote the use of meaningful Agile and product metrics to measure delivery health, predictability, flow, quality, risk, dependencies, customer value, and business impact.
* Help teams and leaders use metrics to make better decisions, identify improvement opportunities, and demonstrate progress against strategic objectives.
* Conduct regular program reviews with stakeholders to provide visibility into delivery progress, risks, dependencies, value delivered, and outcomes achieved.
* Ensure Agile measurement practices are used to drive learning, prioritization, and continuous improvement rather than solely administrative reporting.


**Continuous Improvement and Innovation**
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and measurable value delivery across CCFT.
* Identify systemic delivery impediments and partner with leaders and teams to remove barriers that limit speed, quality, predictability, or business value.
* Drive improvements in planning, execution, feedback loops, prioritization, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Develop reusable accelerators, playbooks, coaching models, and operating practices that improve Agile maturity and business effectiveness.
* Encourage experimentation and learning to help teams improve delivery outcomes and respond more effectively to changing business needs.


**Agile Transformation Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as a change agent by promoting the business value of SAFe, Agile ways of working, DPOM, and product\-oriented delivery.
* Collaborate with leaders, stakeholders, and business partners to build shared understanding of how Agile transformation supports CCFT’s strategic goals and business outcomes.
* Help teams and stakeholders overcome resistance to change by clearly connecting new ways of working to improved delivery, stronger alignment, and better outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships with the Agile Enablement team to scale knowledge sharing, accelerate capability development, and improve organizational Agile maturity.
* Participate in stakeholder and leadership meetings to communicate transformation progress, business impact, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities.


**Program Execution and Delivery Accountability**
* Support efficient program execution across CCFT by helping teams improve planning discipline, dependency management, risk management, decision\-making, and delivery accountability.
* Partner with Scrum Masters, RTEs, Product Analysts, Product Managers, and stakeholders to improve team performance and ensure execution remains aligned with business priorities.
* Help teams understand stakeholder needs, decision\-making workflows, business processes, and information requirements to improve delivery relevance and business value.
* Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including teams in the United States and international locations, to improve consistency, transparency, and delivery outcomes.
* Ensure Agile delivery practices support product strategy, business objectives, operational excellence, and enterprise priorities.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**
* 12 \-17 years of experience managing, mentoring, and developing Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, Product Analysts, or Product Managers.
* Direct hands\-on experience with Agile and product software delivery in roles such as Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer, Product Owner or Product Manager, Agile Coach, or SAFe Practice Consultant.
* Proven experience leading Agile transformations that delivered measurable improvements in delivery performance, team maturity, stakeholder alignment, or business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of SAFe principles, Agile delivery practices, Lean\-Agile mindset, Agile governance, product management, and continuous improvement methods.
* Experience facilitating Agile training, workshops, coaching sessions, transformation planning, and outcome\-based improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence leaders and teams at all levels.
* Experience collaborating with global and geographically dispersed teams.
* Ability to connect Agile practices with business objectives, product outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.
* Ability to foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and measurable value delivery.


**Preferred Experience**
* SAFe Practice Consultant certification or equivalent SAFe leadership experience.
* Experience supporting Agile Release Trains, PI Planning, Inspect and Adapt events, ART execution, and Agile program or portfolio governance.
* Experience building Agile maturity models, value measurement frameworks, metrics dashboards, coaching playbooks, or transformation accelerators.
* Experience driving improvements in time\-to\-market, delivery predictability, quality, stakeholder satisfaction, operational efficiency, or product value realization.


**Leadership Expectations**
 The Agile Transformation Leader is expected to be a business\-focused delivery leader who helps CCFT improve how it delivers strategic value. This role requires strong people leadership, business acumen, transformation execution, stakeholder influence, and the ability to connect Agile practices to measurable outcomes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will model Lean\-Agile behaviors, promote transparency, strengthen accountability, and help teams continuously improve how they plan, prioritize, deliver, measure, and realize business value.
