title: Manager - Engineering
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For…**
 ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people\-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI\-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 You’ll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full\-time employees and, covering responsibilities across:
   

  

**People \& Growth**
* Conduct regular 1:1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support.
* Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires.
* Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor\-to\-FTE conversion process.
* Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review.
* Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics.
* Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure.


**Delivery \& Execution**
* Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope.
* Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning.
* Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding.
* Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders.


**Technical Leadership**
* Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work.
* Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Sponsoring and helping lead cross\-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release\-process automation.
* Running demo sessions and hands\-on skill\-building with the team on key technical areas.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance.
* Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI\-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems.
* Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands\-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle.


**Org Design**
* Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally\-led working groups.
* A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time.


**Qualities you possess…**
* Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3\-5 years leading engineering teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed.
* Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first\-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet.
* Self\-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Technical Competence:
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems.
* Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks.
* Proficiency in database technologies and event\-driven architecture.
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI\-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade\-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work.
* Leadership \& Management:
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high\-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross\-team coordination.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership.


**As a plus, you have...**
* Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment.
* Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks.
* Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains.
* Engineering background with hands\-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud\-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React.
* Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI\-DLC) and or TDD


*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
 ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.
   

  

 www.sciencelogic.com

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 Being a member of testing team under IT Enterprise Architecture Data and Corporate Technology department, the Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non\-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In\-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non\-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Responsible for system integration testing, including automation, of newly developed or enhanced applications.
* Play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete results.
* Lead, develop, and advise on test automation strategies and provide critical feedback in requirements, design, implementation and execution phases.
* Partner with collaborators \- Product Management, Application Development, DevOps and other technical teams.
* Track test execution milestones and report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
* Construct appropriate end\-2\-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
* Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
* Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
* Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the product(s) being delivered.
* Responsible for process compliance \& associated documentation
* Aligns risk and control processes into day\-to\-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
* Works closely with business and application development domain experts, to continually improve depth and breadth of knowledge for assigned applications/systems.
* Responsible for Project Coordination and Technical Management tasks.


 \*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\*
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum 6 years of related experience in delivering software solutions with hands on automated testing.
* Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Experience in Agile/Waterfall, onsite/offshore work model and coordination.
* In depth knowledge of the software implementation lifecycle (specifically the testing model, methodology, and processes).
* Experience with Test Engineering methodologies and Test Automation Frameworks
* Proficient in automation at all software layers (e.g. UI, services, APIs, etc.) as well as CI/CD technologies (e.g. Cloudbees, Jenkins, Cucumber, Git, JUnit, Jira, etc.).
* Sophisticated Java / Selenium development skills with significant experience applying those skills in test environments.
* Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
* Extensive experience with testing modern scripting language\-based components.
* Proven expertise in frontend test automation using Selenium Webdriver.
* Expert and hands on with backend test automation for API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
* Experience in writing sophisticated SQL queries.
* Experience with JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Git, and Jenkins.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**Role:**
 As a Senior Quality Engineer \- you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across StarRez communication, Marketplace, System Administration and Maintenance systems. You will be an expert within our product engineering organization, deeply understanding user and product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support StarRez personas. This role will balance hands\-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers.
   

  

 This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end\-to\-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process.
   

  

 Your role is not to manage a team, but to be a quality champion who partners directly with developers, product managers, designers, support, implementation, and customer\-facing teams. You will help teams anticipate risk, clarify expected behaviour, validate business logic, protect the customer experience, and build more robust, scalable, and reliable conference and event products. At the core of this role is a strong focus on the customer experience; success means our platform behaves predictably, is easy to use, and enables our resident communities to thrive.
   

  

**What You Will Own:**
* Own and drive end\-to\-end quality for the StarRez Foundations product team.
* Champion StarRez's quality standards by establishing, maintaining, and advocating for quality gates and rapid feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute testing, validation and risk mitigation strategies for feature related initiatives.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non\-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real customer operations and the intended product experience.
* Champion shift\-left quality culture by mentoring developers, product managers, and design partners on testing principles, behavioural specifications, clear acceptance criteria, early validation, fast feedback loops, and production\-quality observability.
* Work effectively with ambiguity, proactively designing quality solutions based on evidence when clear requirements, behaviour definitions, customer workflow expectations, or quality baselines do not yet exist.
* Champion test automation best practices, create clear testing standards, and coach engineers to take shared ownership of building and maintaining automated tests.
* Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes.
* Own production defect triage for your product domain, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Support to assess impact, prioritise fixes, identify root causes, and drive preventative quality improvements.


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed systems environments
* SQL. Required for test data setup, backend validation, data integrity checks across integrations, and root cause analysis.
* Tech stack context (.NET/C\#, SQL Server, Azure).
* API testing tooling (Postman, REST Assured, or similar).
* Cloud platform exposure (Azure/AWS).
* Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence\-based approaches.
* Hands\-on experience working with web\-based products, including front\-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Build\-kite, or similar platforms.
* Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection, environment readiness checks.
* Genuine curiosity and passion for understanding product architecture, user experience flows, customer workflows, analytics use cases, and the business impact of engineering and data decisions.
* Experience utilising AI in modern software development.


**Reasons to join our team:**
* Opportunity to be a part of a well\-established, high\-performance company that has been in business for over 30\+ years
* Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
* A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
* Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
* Z\-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high\-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.


 Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

 for our

Take absolute ownership of frontend experiences, backend scalability, automated testing, and production stability.

 Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable technical architectures, customer journeys, APIs, and platform capabilities.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar quantitative/engineering discipline.

* 3\-5\+ years leading engineering teams



  





**Note:** 




 Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
description:
**Position: Senior Testing Lead \- Automation, Performance, Security \& Functional QA**
**Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)**
**Work Type: Full\-Time/Onsite**
**Experience: 8\+ Years**
**PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8\+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data\-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on\-premise environments.**
**Roles \& Responsibilities** 
**Quality Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data\-integrity testing.
* Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting.
* Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data\-correctness risks.
* Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision.
* Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality\-first engineering culture.
* Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams.


**Test Automation**
* Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence.
* Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation.


**Functional \& Migration Testing**
* Own end\-to\-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios.
* Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases.
* Design test scenarios based on real\-world customer data migration use cases.
* Validate migration correctness from source to destination.
* Test multi\-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation.
* Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring.


**Data Validation \& Integrity** 
  

  

* Build automated source\-to\-target data validation frameworks.
* Validate:
+ Record counts
+ Field\-level accuracy
+ Data mappings
+ Relationships and associations
+ Transformations
+ Deduplication
+ Overall data integrity

* Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results.
* Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent.


**Performance Testing**
* Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing.
* Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations.
* Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them.
* Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline.


**Security Testing**
* Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform.
* Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross\-tenant data access is possible.
* Validate authentication and authorization controls.
* Perform input validation and abuse\-case testing.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD.
* Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors.
* Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence.


**Technical Quality \& Delivery**
* Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready.
* Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with developers to identify defects early.
* Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality.
* Support both cloud and on\-premise deployments.
* Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation.


**Note: Should be highly self\-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones.**
**Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones**
**Required Skills**
* 8\+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience.
* Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products.
* Strong hands\-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium.
* Strong API and REST testing experience.
* Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java.
* Hands\-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning.
* Strong SQL and data\-validation experience.
* Experience validating source\-to\-target data integrity across multiple systems.
* Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data\-intensive applications.
* Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with on\-premise/customer\-deployed software is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus.

 The

 will manage the end\-to\-end release lifecycle for the

 **7 years of experience**

 **primary Scrum Master** 
 , facilitating teams and removing delivery impediments.

 , including Boards, Pipelines, Release Management, Test Plans and Dashboards.

 Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, globally distributed environments
* Self\-starter with strong prioritization and multitasking capabilities


**Technical Qualifications**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Proven ability to drive innovation, strategic initiatives, and cross\-functional programs

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. * Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees

* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: TD&E-FS-Technical Scrum Master- Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**echnology Consulting**
**Title:** 
**Specialist II, Technical Scrum Lead**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

**Client Technology (CT) \-** 
 focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** 
 EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** 
 Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, to keep teams aligned and productive.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead cross\-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.
* Coach teams on best practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improving agile maturity.
* Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to define, prioritize and align technology\-related outcomes with business goals.
* Identify and proactively remove roadblocks that hinder project progress, ensuring teams have the necessary resources and support.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparency around scope, schedule and budget while effectively addressing concerns.
* Facilitate key agile ceremonies such as daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Assist teams in estimating deliverables, increasing velocity and identifying opportunities for efficiency.
* Maintain product and sprint backlogs, ensuring tasks are documented, prioritized and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology\-related product development.
* Serve as a mentor, thought leader and agile champion, participating in special projects to drive organizational agility.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and Professional Scrum Master (CSM, PSM, SAFe) certification is preferred.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

title: Project Coordinator- Migration
description:
**Migration Coordinator** 




**Location: India \- Remote** 




  





**Job Profile Summary** 




 The Migration Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and governing day\-to\-day migration activities across multiple customers, workstreams, and technical teams. This role serves as the central coordination point between Project Managers, Program Managers, technical delivery teams, service management teams, customers, and third\-party partners to ensure migration activities are planned, scheduled, executed, and tracked in accordance with program objectives.
 



 The role combines migration coordination and PMO responsibilities, including migration wave scheduling, migration readiness management, customer communications, ServiceNow or any ticket governance, reporting, tracking of planned versus actual delivery status, and risk and dependency management. The Migration Coordinator is expected to maintain accurate migration data, provide visibility into program progress, proactively identify issues, and support effective program governance.
 



  





**Career Level Summary** 



* Manages routine and complex migration coordination activities across multiple customers and workstreams.
* Works with technical and business stakeholders to support migration planning, execution, and governance.



  





**Critical Competencies** 



* Excellence: Delivers high\-quality coordination and governance support through strong attention to detail, accountability, and consistent execution.
* Customer\-Driven: Ensures customers are informed, prepared, and supported throughout migration planning and execution activities.
* Expertise: Applies PMO and migration coordination knowledge to maintain control over schedules, readiness activities, reporting, governance, and ticket management processes.
* Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across technical teams, program leadership, operational teams, customers, and external partners.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage day\-to\-day migration wave scheduling and coordination activities across multiple customers, services, applications, and infrastructure environments.
* Maintain migration schedules and ensure alignment with program milestones, migration roadmaps, and delivery objectives.
* Coordinate migration dates, resource availability, dependencies, readiness activities, and prerequisites required for successful execution.
* Track migration readiness and ensure required approvals; validations, access requirements, and prerequisites are completed before scheduled migration dates.
* Identify scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, delivery risks, and dependency\-related challenges, escalating where appropriate.
* Manage migration\-related customer communications, including scheduling notifications, reminders, status updates, confirmations, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain high standards of ServiceNow or any other ticket management governance across migration activities.
* Ensure migration\-related tickets are accurately created, assigned, categorized, updated, reviewed, and closed according to agreed processes.
* Maintain migration trackers, action logs, RAID logs, readiness trackers, dashboards, and governance documentation.
* Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency registers and ensure assigned owners actively progress in remediation activities.
* Act as the primary coordination point between migration teams, project managers, service management teams, operations, customers, and external vendors.



  





**Knowledge** 



* Knowledge of PMO methodologies, governance frameworks, reporting processes, and project coordination practices.
* Proven ability to identify schedule slippage, risks, dependencies, and blockers and drive appropriate follow\-up actions.



  





**Skills** 



* Migration Coordination
* PMO Governance and Reporting
* Migration Wave Planning and Scheduling
* Stakeholder Management (Internal and External)
* Customer Communication Management
* ServiceNow / ITSM Platforms
* Schedule Management and Tracking
* Migration Readiness Management
* Risk, Issue, Action and Dependency Management (RAID)
* Data Analysis and Reporting
* Microsoft Excel, Dashboards and Tracker Management



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields required.



  





**Certifications** 



* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent Project Management Certification preferred.
* Agile Foundation, Scrum Fundamentals, or comparable project delivery certification preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 3\-6 years of experience in PMO, project coordination, migration coordination, transition management, service delivery, or related operational roles.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) – Data Technical Program Management
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 As a Senior consultant within the GES Technology Group, reporting to Digital delivery leader, you will work closely with Product and engineering functions to lead cross\-functional programs spanning data engineering, analytics, integration, architecture, product, security, and business stakeholders. You will drive delivery of scalable data platforms and integration solutions, including initiatives involving AI driven analytics, master data management, data lake enablement, APIs, event\-driven integrations, Model Context Protocol implementations and others.
   

  

 You will serve as the connective tissue across business, product, engineering, and leadership teams—ensuring that complex data and integration programs are delivered with clear outcomes, disciplined execution, and effective risk management.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
   

  

 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end Compliance PMO plan for software releases, including SSDLC governance milestones, approval dependencies, timelines, and escalation paths.
* Drive coordination of all required compliance approvals for releases, including BISO, quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, and other governance signoffs as applicable.
* Coordinate and gather information required for compliance documentation, including data privacy assessments, risk inputs, control evidence, and supporting artifacts from various product domain teams.
* Drive engagement with member firm and local geography risk leaders to socialize release scope, confirm required risk considerations, share evidence of global risk compliance process approvals and coordinate responses to questions pertaining to risk controls of the software and/or process.
* Partner with product, engineering, QA, security, privacy, risk, operations, and business teams to ensure release deliverables meet SSDLC control requirements before go/no\-go decisions.
* Maintain a centralized compliance tracker that captures approval status, required artifacts, open risks, blockers, owners, target dates, and closure evidence for each release.
* Identify, document, monitor, and escalate compliance risks, approval delays, control gaps, and release readiness issues with clear mitigation plans and ownership.
* Facilitate compliance readiness reviews, approval checkpoints, risk reviews, and compliance go/no\-go meetings to support timely and controlled release decisions.
* Ensure required release evidence is complete, current, auditable, and aligned to applicable quality and risk, privacy, cyber, and SSDLC standards.
* Provide regular executive\-ready reporting on compliance approval status, key risks, decisions needed, and upcoming governance milestones.
* Continuously improve Compliance PMO processes, approval workflows, templates, dashboards, and documentation to increase transparency and reduce release friction.
* Support post\-release reviews by capturing lessons learned, compliance exceptions, residual risks, and process improvement opportunities.
* Support hypercare and on\-demand release activities by confirming required compliance approvals, documenting exceptions, and coordinating time\-sensitive governance decisions for high\-priority production issues.


 Key Skills:
   

  

* Ideally 5\+ years of experience working in technical program management, technology delivery, data engineering, integration, analytics, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi\-team data, integration, analytics, or platform programs.

* Strong understanding of data lifecycle concepts, including ingestion, transformation, storage, modeling, quality, governance, and consumption.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, batch processing, event\-driven integration, file exchange, and application\-to\-application integration.
* Experience coordinating data platform or data lake implementations.
* Experience with master data management, data quality, data governance, or Informatica\-based solutions.
* Familiarity with data lakehouse architectures and technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and AI\-enabled data or system integrations.
* Experience with data catalogs, lineage, metadata management, data observability, or data mesh concepts.
* Familiarity with analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft suite of applications such as Excel, PowerPoint, Project and other collaboration tools such as SharePoint and Teams
* Strong working knowledge of SSDLC governance, release readiness controls, approval checkpoints, and evidence management
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional compliance approvals across quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, engineering, QA, operations, and business stakeholders
* Ability to manage compliance trackers, release dashboards, approval artifacts, audit evidence, RAID logs, and executive\-ready status reporting
* Able to collaborate effectively as part of a global, remote team
* Strong analytical, consultative, quantitative, and project management skills
* Strong executive presence, excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills with an aptitude for working as part of a global team
* Problem solving, critical thinking and conceptual thinking skills

title: Engineering Manager - MeanStack
description:
**About the Role:** 




 The Engineering Manager position entails the leadership of MCO global product development teams across the entirety of the software development life cycle. This role focuses on our MEAN stack platform (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js) hosted on AWS, with MongoDB Atlas as the primary data layer. Key responsibilities encompass ensuring the quality of team outputs and optimizing customer experiences, along with maintaining strict adherence to coding standards and promoting automation initiatives.
 



 The role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes across AWS infrastructure, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Agile \& Team Leadership** 



* Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team.
* Be responsible for the quality of the teams’ outputs and the customer experience of our products.
* Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC, from requirements gathering through production deployment on AWS.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high\-quality software products.
* Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development, with emphasis on modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices.



**Technical Leadership – MEAN Stack \& AWS** 



* Hands\-on participation in all technical activities including architecture and design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, and defect triage across the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
* Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team for TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular component architecture, RESTful API design, and Node.js services.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards across the full stack.
* Oversee MongoDB Atlas configuration, schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, and data migration processes.
* Drive architecture decisions for AWS services including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and related infrastructure.
* Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies, particularly around scalability, security, and cloud cost optimisation.



**Delivery \& Operations** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications.
* Drive automation in the engineering teams, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated testing.
* Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Platform Test teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of software products.
* Oversee deployment and release processes using AWS\-based CI/CD to ensure smooth and reliable product launches.
* Monitor system performance via CloudWatch, application logging, and APM tooling; address technical issues promptly to maintain product stability.
* Provide technical leadership during incidents and outages, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution across the application and infrastructure layers.



**Experiences and Skills** 




**Required** 



* 10\+ years of experience in product development (including up to 3 years in engineering management).
* Strong full\-stack engineering experience with the MEAN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular (2\+), and Node.js in a product development environment.
* Proven experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, and RDS/DocumentDB or MongoDB Atlas.
* Hands\-on proficiency with MongoDB Atlas: cluster management, performance tuning, indexing, aggregation framework, change streams, and backup/restore strategies.
* Maintain hands\-on involvement with coding approximately 20% of the time.
* Expertise in architecture and design reviews, system design, code reviews, customer issues, troubleshooting, and defect triage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex distributed\-systems issues.
* Demonstrates resilience and flexibility, consistently adapting while managing priorities with efficiency.
* A strong willingness to learn and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication and servant\-leadership skills.
* Knowledge and experience of agile development methodology (Scrum, Agile, and Kanban).



**Preferred** 



* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK).
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS).
* Experience with event\-driven architectures, message queues (SQS, SNS, Kafka), and microservices patterns.
* Background in a product\-driven SaaS or financial services company.



 Architect\-level experience is a plus.
